<!--
  The simple team (model team@1): the heading, a description and the members as a list, each with a portrait,
  the name and a line. Axes: layout (grid: the portrait over the copy, aside: the head beside large square
  portraits from md up, byline: a small disc beside the copy, list: a larger disc beside the copy, two columns),
  cols (2, 3, 4 columns from md up), surface (plain, cards: each member on a card surface).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { SimpleMember } from "./team-simple.types";

export type TeamSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  members: SimpleMember[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  layout?: "grid" | "aside" | "byline" | "list";
  cols?: "2" | "3" | "4";
  surface?: "plain" | "cards";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  members,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  layout = "grid",
  cols = "3",
  surface = "plain",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<TeamSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const frame = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "aside" ? "md:grid md:grid-cols-3 md:items-start"
  : ""
);
const grid = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "aside" ? "md:col-span-2 md:grid-cols-3"
  : (cols as string) === "2" ? ""
  : (cols as string) === "3" ? "md:grid-cols-3"
  : "md:grid-cols-4"
);
const person = computed(() =>
  ((layout as string) === "byline") || ((layout as string) === "list") ? "flex w-full flex-row items-center gap-4"
  : (align as string) === "center" ? "flex w-full flex-col items-center gap-4"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "flex w-full flex-col items-end gap-4"
  : "flex w-full flex-col items-start gap-4"
);
const portrait = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "aside" ? "w-full"
  : (layout as string) === "byline" ? "size-12 rounded-full"
  : "size-16 rounded-full"
);
const copyAlign = computed(() =>
  ((layout as string) === "byline") || ((layout as string) === "list") ? "start"
  : column.value
);
const copyText = computed(() =>
  ((layout as string) === "byline") || ((layout as string) === "list") ? "text-start"
  : textAlign.value
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="team-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Stack gap="12" align="stretch" :class="frame">
        <Stack gap="4" :align="column" :class="cn('max-w-2xl', selfAlign)">
          <Title :as="level" size="3xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 grid w-full list-none grid-cols-1 gap-8 p-0 sm:grid-cols-2', grid)">
          <ListItem v-for="m in members" :key="m.id"
            :class="cn(
              person,
              (
                (surface as string) === 'cards' ? 'rounded bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground border border-border'
                : ''
              )
            )"
            data-slot="member"
          >
            <MediaFrame :alt="m.title" :src="m.avatar" ratio="1/1" :class="cn('shrink-0', portrait)" />
            <Stack gap="2" :align="copyAlign">
              <Title :as="(level + 1)" size="lg" weight="semibold" :class="copyText">
                {{ m.title }}
              </Title>
              <Text v-if="m.description" size="sm" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', copyText)">
                {{ m.description }}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
